CHARACTER SHEET LIGHTING MODIFICATION — HERO

Use the supplied HERO character sheet as the EXACT MASTER REFERENCE.

Do NOT redesign the character.

Do NOT regenerate a different version of HERO.

Preserve the character sheet exactly as supplied.

Preserve:

same age,
same youthful appearance,
same bald head,
same pale gray-ivory skin,
same facial structure,
same body proportions,
same height,
same clothing,
same woven robe,
same layered ash-gray and bone-beige fabrics,
same fabric construction,
same barefoot appearance,
same pose,
same silhouette,
same identity,
same character-sheet composition,
same camera angles,
same background,
same lighting,
same visual style.

ONLY MODIFY THE TWO FOLLOWING ELEMENTS:

==================================================
1. HERO'S EYES
==================================================

Add a subtle supernatural BLUE-TO-PALE-CYAN LUMINOSITY to HERO'S eyes.

The eyes must glow with a soft luminous blue.

Color:

pale cyan,
light blue,
soft icy blue,
slightly luminous.

The glow should feel like an internal energy source.

The illumination must be clearly visible but controlled.

Do NOT make the eyes neon.

Do NOT make them extremely bright.

Do NOT create a large halo around the face.

The light should remain concentrated around the eye area.

The blue light should subtly illuminate the immediate surrounding facial area.

The effect must look physically integrated with the character.

IMPORTANT:

Preserve the EXACT existing eye design and eye shape from the supplied character sheet.

Do NOT redesign the eyes.

Do NOT enlarge the eyes.

Do NOT change their shape.

Do NOT change their position.

Do NOT change HERO's facial proportions.

Only add the blue-pale-cyan luminous effect.

==================================================
2. HERO'S HAND MARK / SYMBOL
==================================================

The existing MARK / SYMBOL on HERO'S HAND must also glow with the SAME blue-to-pale-cyan luminous energy.

Preserve the EXACT original shape of the mark.

Do NOT redesign it.

Do NOT change its geometry.

Do NOT move it.

Do NOT enlarge it.

Do NOT create a new symbol.

Only make the existing mark emit a subtle pale blue / cyan light.

The glow should originate directly from the mark.

The illumination should softly spill onto the surrounding skin.

The intensity and color temperature must visually match the glow of HERO'S eyes.

EYES and HAND MARK must feel powered by the SAME energy source.

==================================================
LIGHT COLOR
==================================================

The exact luminous color should be:

soft icy blue,
pale cyan,
light blue,
slightly desaturated blue.

Avoid saturated electric blue.

Avoid deep blue.

Avoid neon blue.

Avoid turquoise.

The final effect should feel:

mysterious,
ancient,
supernatural,
subtle,
cinematic,
photorealistic.

==================================================
LIGHTING INTERACTION
==================================================

The blue-cyan light must physically interact with HERO.

Very subtle blue illumination should appear on:

the immediate skin around the eyes,
the nearby facial contours,
the fingers and skin surrounding the hand mark,
nearby fabric where appropriate.

Keep the illumination subtle.

Do NOT turn the entire character blue.

Do NOT change the established gray-ivory skin tone.

Do NOT change the robe colors.

Do NOT change the environment.

Do NOT introduce blue ambient lighting into the entire scene.

The luminous effect must remain localized to:

HERO'S EYES
and
HERO'S HAND MARK.

==================================================
CHARACTER SHEET CONTINUITY
==================================================

Every panel and every view in the supplied character sheet must show the EXACT SAME luminous treatment.

The eye glow remains consistent across all views.

The hand-mark glow remains consistent across all views.

The intensity remains consistent.

The color remains consistent.

The character remains completely identical otherwise.

No variation between panels.

No redesigned facial features.

No altered proportions.

No costume changes.

No age changes.

==================================================
VISUAL QUALITY
==================================================

Ultra-realistic live-action feature-film character reference.

Photorealistic skin.

Photorealistic woven fabric.

Natural material response.

Physically believable luminous effect.

Subtle cinematic bloom.

Very controlled light scattering.

Natural shadows.

Natural skin response to the blue-cyan light.

High-end science-fiction psychological horror aesthetic.

The result must look like the SAME ORIGINAL HERO CHARACTER SHEET with ONLY the eye glow and hand-mark glow added.

NOT a new character.

NOT a redesign.

NOT a different character sheet.

NOT a stylized reinterpretation.

NOT neon.

NOT cartoon.

NOT fantasy illustration.

NO additional elements.

NO additional characters.

NO additional symbols.

NO text.

NO labels.

NO logos.

NO watermark.

CRITICAL FINAL INSTRUCTION:

PRESERVE THE SUPPLIED HERO CHARACTER SHEET EXACTLY.

ONLY ADD:

PALE BLUE-CYAN GLOW TO THE EYES

AND

PALE BLUE-CYAN GLOW TO THE EXISTING HAND MARK.

EVERYTHING ELSE MUST REMAIN UNCHANGED. <<<2210cf4b-63fc-4c15-b825-0e6673fdddc2>>>
